rows.note: This is the all-purpose standalone word for an administrative province.

example.english: Each province in Canada has its own government.
example.traditional: 加拿大嘅每個省份都有自己嘅政府。
example.jyutping: gaa1 naa4 daai6 ge3 mui5 go3 saang2 fan6 dou1 jau5 zi6 gei2 ge3 zing3 fu2

rows.note: Use this shorter form especially in names such as 廣東省 or when the provincial context is clear.

example.english: My family home is in Guangdong province.
example.jyutping: ngo5 uk1 kei2 hai2 gwong2 dung1 saang2
